summary: Iteration 40 — Phase 2 (Solar Pump + per-system fields), Phase 3 (Material Kits CRUD + seed-starter + auto-match), and Phase 4 (Draft Resume + Review dialog) tested end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases passed. Frontend: MaterialKitsPage renders 8 seeded kits, filters work, Add Kit dialog opens, Inventory has Solution Kits link, New Project wizard shows Solar Pump option, pump-details block, kit-suggestion → Apply Kit populates selected_items and shows applied-banner, draft resume banner appears & restores form, discard clears. Review dialog testids exist in code and materials/apply-kit flow reaches it (full end-to-end submit blocked only by an unrelated required custom form-builder field 'Warranty Type').

issues: Phase 1 was supposed to teardown What3Words — but the 'What3Words Address' card + validation error 'Enter What3Words or site address' is still visible on the Location step. Per this iteration's scope this was NOT re-tested (phase 1) but is worth noting as a residual UI element. Not a blocker.
